sections.title: Record in any currency
sections.description: Tap the currency symbol to log a purchase in another currency. Spenzy converts it for you, or enter the exact amount your bank charged.

sections.title: Foreign receipts just work
sections.description: Receipts in other currencies are now converted automatically.

sections.title: Manage friends and categories
items: Edit or remove Split Bill friends, several at once.
All categories now in one list.
CSV import creates missing categories for you.

sections.title: Fixes & Improvements
items: Receipt scanning and adding by text are working again. Sorry for the interruption, and thanks for your patience!
More accurate totals for foreign-currency wallets, and changing your main currency updates everything right away.
Wallet PDF reports now include every transaction and the correct total.
Siri understands "Spenzy" better, and text shortcuts now save a note.
